My dear [Mrs Keble](../persons.html#797)
How very stupid and ungrateful you must have thought me, but I never saw your [Son](../persons.html#799)’s letter when I opened – and answered yours, and only found it this morning.

It satisfies me all the more as being what I was always inclined to think.

yours affectionately

C M Yonge

[^1]: Written on paper used between 1864 and 1868.

It seems probable that the query related to the life of [John Keble](../persons.html#798).
